prompt: Create a polished anime-style half-body portrait of Artoria Pendragon as a casually dressed young woman with fair skin, bright teal-blue eyes, and pale blonde hair. She has straight bangs framing her face, one long ahoge strand curving upward from the crown, and her hair pulled back into a neat braided bun secured with a large dark navy ribbon bow visible behind her head. Show her from about mid-thigh upward, standing at a slight angle with a gentle confident smile, head subtly tilted, one hand resting on her hip and the other arm relaxed downward. Her outfit contains exactly 2 visible clothing pieces: a cream-white ribbed off-shoulder knit sweater with long sleeves pushed slightly up at the forearms, and high-waisted dark blue denim jeans with belt loops, metal button, stitching, and front pockets. Emphasize soft shoulders and collarbones, delicate facial features, clean line art, smooth cel shading, and refined anime illustration detail. Use warm indoor studio lighting with golden bokeh highlights, a softly blurred neutral gray-beige background, and a bright lens flare glow in the upper right. The composition should be vertical, intimate, elegant, and softly romantic, with no text, no watermark, and no extra characters.
